title: Usage record
description: Body of a `receipt` artifact holding what one accounting unit (a Worker run, a model call, a website turn) consumed, taken from an objective source (design/resources.md). Field names follow the OpenTelemetry GenAI usage attributes. Never a model's self-report.

requestId.description: Deduplication key: the source's own id for the unit counted (an Agent SDK result message's session and uuid, an API response id). The ledger keeps one record per (source, requestId).

source.description: Where the numbers come from: the runtime's result message, the provider's usage fields in a response, an agent's session transcript (reconciliation), system's own turn count, or an invoice.

pool.description: The configured resource pool the usage is drawn from, e.g. an account's interactive window, its programmatic credit, or an API key.

providerName.description: gen_ai.provider.name. Informational: routing never branches on it (INV-11).

usage.description: Totals of the unit, every model included.

models.description: The same totals split per model, when the source gives them (the Agent SDK's modelUsage covers subagents too).

turns.description: Website turns or agent turns counted, for pools metered in turns.

basis.description: runtime-estimate: the runtime's own client-side figure; price-table: computed from the usage and a versioned price table; invoice: billed.

priceVersion.description: The price table the amount was computed with, so history is never repriced.

outcome.description: How the unit ended. A failed run is metered too.

partial.description: (1.1, with `runId`) The record is a lower bound of its run, and why, in plain words: the run ended before its runtime's final count (a stop, a timeout, a drain, a deferred call), and its numbers are what the runtime reported while it ran; or the run ran again after the host's stop cut it, and its numbers are only what it used since (T283). Counted, never the run's usage: the run stays unknown, and a cap of its scope and pool fails closed, until the ledger counts a record of it in that pool without `partial` (INV-2, ADR-0065). The record says it itself, so no other write is needed for that.
